mapper.sql: apr15_repr_corp_id AS repr_corp_id , apr15_corp_type AS corp_type , apr15_corp_type_nm AS corp_type_name , apr15_corp_nm AS corp_name , apr15_repr_nm AS repr_name , apr15_corp_reg_yn AS corp_reg_yn , apr15_stamp_id AS stamp_id , apr15_stamp_nm AS stamp_name , apr15_note AS note , apr15_use_yn AS use_yn
mapper.select: SELECT FROM ( SELECT apr15_repr_corp.* , f_cdnm('ReprCorpType', apr15_corp_type, apr15_company_id, f_today()) AS apr15_corp_type_nm , apr10_stamp_nm AS apr15_stamp_nm FROM apr15_repr_corp LEFT JOIN apr10_stamp ON apr10_stamp_id = apr15_stamp_id WHERE apr15_company_id = #{companyId} ) t ORDER BY apr15_corp_type, apr15_corp_nm COLLATE "ko_KR.utf8"
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO apr15_repr_corp (apr15_repr_corp_id, apr15_company_id, apr15_corp_type, apr15_corp_nm, apr15_repr_nm, apr15_corp_reg_yn, apr15_stamp_id, apr15_note, apr15_use_yn) VALUES (#{r.reprCorpId}, #{companyId}, #{r.corpType}, #{r.corpName}, #{r.reprName}, #{r.corpRegYn}, #{r.stampId}, #{r.note}, #{r.useYn})
